chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: Julia Lee, rejoining Basie briefly, then back to Kansas City
summary: Smith played with Julia Lee, followed Basie to Scranton, was dropped, and returned to Kansas City to form his own bands.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah. Come back there. No, I come back by myself, and got with Julia Lee, George Lee's sister, and played a while out there with her on her little jobs.
That was a regular place in Kansas City?
Yeah. Called Midlands(?) Tap Room. Yeah, a little beer tavern.
How many pieces in that band?

Yeah. She wanted me to play with her out there. She was just playing the piano by herself and singing. So I played out there a while, then Basie arrived in town and he sent for me. And I went on and followed them around up to Cleveland, got up there in Cleveland and rehearsing(?) went on. I don't know what happened, but anyway, I got over to Scranton, Pennsylvania, and he said he had to keep one of the boys, had to keep Couchy Roberts on the alto... I don't know why. I guess
John Hammond or someone told him he couldn't take me back in the band any more. So I left.

He gave me a little change, and I left there and went on to Buffalo, New York, stayed around there and played awhile with a boy, a little three-piece band in a club there. And my wife was still in Omaha, and I finally went on back to Omaha. I stayed there a while with nothin' goin' on. Then I came back to Kansas City; that's when I organized them bands.
